title: Generate Exports Map Executor Schema
description: Generates the package.json "exports" map of an assembled npm package from its per-directory package.json stubs and type declarations.

packageDir.description: Assembled npm package directory (root package.json plus per-directory stubs with main/module/typings).

ignore.description: Directories (relative to packageDir) to skip when looking for stubs and type-only modules.

extraExports.description: Subpath entries appended to the generated map as-is, such as asset folders or wildcard patterns.
